acceptedAnswer.text: Converting a garage into a guest house in Henderson requires adherence to specific local building codes and zoning ordinances. You will need permits for structural changes, plumbing, electrical, and mechanical systems. The City of Henderson has specific requirements regarding setbacks, parking, occupancy, and design standards for accessory dwelling units (ADUs). It's crucial to ensure your plans comply with these regulations to avoid delays or issues. We assist with navigating the permitting process and ensuring all work meets local standards.
